items.q_en: A customer has just paid for a reveal. Walk me through what the accountant does.
items.q_ar: دفع عميل للتو مقابل كشف، اشرح لي ما يفعله المحاسب.
items.q_reworded: Someone just paid to unlock a supplier. What does finance do next?
answer_must: Confirm the payment in Stripe and book it
File the invoice with a Dropbox backup and make it visible in the portal

items.q_en: Does the reveal fee carry VAT?
items.q_ar: هل تخضع رسوم الكشف لضريبة القيمة المضافة؟
items.q_reworded: Do we add 5% tax on top of our unlock charge?
answer_must: No VAT is charged on the fee while QuotesDone is not VAT-registered

items.q_en: Is anything added to the reveal fee for paying by card, and who bears Stripe's fee?
items.q_ar: هل يُضاف أي مبلغ على رسوم الكشف عند الدفع بالبطاقة، ومن يتحمّل رسوم Stripe؟
expected_facts: nothing is added for paying by card
items.q_reworded: If a buyer pays with a credit card, do they pay extra, and who eats the processing cost?
answer_must: No card surcharge is added
QuotesDone bears the Stripe fee (about 2.9% plus AED 1)

items.q_en: On an AED 100,000 quotation, what fee does QuotesDone net?
items.q_ar: على عرض بقيمة 100,000 درهم، كم تصافي كويتس دن من الرسوم؟
items.q_reworded: A quote comes in at a hundred thousand dirhams. What do we keep?
answer_must: QuotesDone nets AED 3,000 (3%)

items.q_en: Can a customer open their Stripe invoice later from the portal?
items.q_ar: هل يستطيع العميل فتح فاتورة Stripe لاحقاً من البوابة؟
items.q_reworded: A buyer lost their receipt. Where can they find it again?
answer_must: The Stripe invoice is available in the customer's portal

items.q_en: Who tells the customer that the payment went through?
items.q_ar: من يبلغ العميل بأن الدفع تم؟
items.q_reworded: Which seat lets the buyer know their card charge succeeded?
answer_must: The sales engineer tells the customer, not Stripe

items.q_en: The CEO signed off one refund. Is that good for the next few as well?
items.q_ar: وافق الرئيس التنفيذي على استرداد واحد، هل تكفي الموافقة للاستردادات التالية؟
items.q_reworded: The boss okayed a refund yesterday. Can I process the other three pending ones too?
answer_must: Each refund needs its own CEO approval
It is executed against the exact Stripe invoice ID

items.q_en: How much does the customer get back on a refunded reveal?
items.q_ar: كم يسترد العميل عند استرداد رسوم كشف؟
items.q_reworded: If we give a buyer their money back, do we deduct the card fee?
answer_must: The customer gets back everything they paid
QuotesDone absorbs the Stripe fee

items.q_en: How often do approved refunds get executed?
items.q_ar: كم مرة تُنفّذ الاستردادات المعتمدة؟
items.q_reworded: After approval, how fast does a refund actually go out?
answer_must: Approved refunds are executed on a 15-minute cycle

items.q_en: How do we book a refund in the ledger?
items.q_ar: كيف نقيد الاسترداد في الدفاتر؟
items.q_reworded: Which ledger account takes the money we hand back?
answer_must: Refunds are booked to 4900 Refunds, not netted silently

items.q_en: Could a retried refund job pay the customer twice?
items.q_ar: هل يمكن لمهمة استرداد أعيد تشغيلها أن تدفع للعميل مرتين؟
items.q_reworded: The refund job crashed and restarted. Could the buyer be paid back twice?
answer_must: Before refunding, Stripe is checked for an existing refund so it is idempotent

items.q_en: A supplier stayed silent and we refunded. What does the supplier owe us?
items.q_ar: لم يرد المورّد فاسترددنا للعميل، ماذا يدين لنا المورّد؟
items.q_reworded: A supplier ignored a paid unlock and we refunded the buyer. What can we bill the supplier?
answer_must: The supplier owes the exact amount refunded plus the processor fee QuotesDone could not recover, an AED 500 admin fee and 12% a year simple interest (Supplier Agreement v14/v15)
An earlier accepted version keeps its own terms: v13 AED 500 and 9%, v10-v12 AED 250 and 9%

items.q_en: Which admin fee applies to a supplier on Supplier Agreement v12?
items.q_ar: ما رسوم الإدارة المطبقة على مورّد وقّع اتفاقية المورد الإصدار 12؟
items.q_reworded: For a supplier signed on version 12 of the agreement, how much is the admin charge?
answer_must: AED 250

items.q_en: The supplier never paid the charge. Is this a police matter?
items.q_ar: المورّد لم يدفع المطالبة أبداً، هل هذه قضية شرطة؟
items.q_reworded: The supplier still has not paid us. Do we file a police complaint?
answer_must: No, it is a civil debt, not a police matter
Recovery goes through a court payment order

items.q_en: How long a payment notice must we give before going to court?
items.q_ar: ما مدة إنذار الوفاء قبل اللجوء للمحكمة؟
items.q_reworded: How much warning must the supplier get before we apply to the judge?
answer_must: A written payment notice of at least 5 days

items.q_en: Once the judge issues the payment order, how long do we have to serve it?
items.q_ar: بعد صدور أمر الأداء، ما المهلة لإعلانه؟
items.q_reworded: The court issued the order. What is the deadline to deliver it to the supplier?
answer_must: It must be served within 3 months

items.q_en: Can we charge interest on the interest the supplier owes?
items.q_ar: هل يمكن احتساب فائدة على الفائدة المستحقة على المورّد؟
items.q_reworded: Can late interest itself attract more interest?
answer_must: No, interest is simple and never compounded

items.q_en: A customer disputed a card payment. What happens to the money?
items.q_ar: اعترض عميل على دفعة بطاقته، ماذا يحدث للمبلغ؟
items.q_reworded: A buyer told their bank they did not recognise our charge. What happens to the funds?
answer_must: Stripe opens a dispute and withdraws the amount plus fee
Evidence must be submitted before the deadline

items.q_en: Why did the customer not receive Stripe's receipt email?
items.q_ar: لماذا لم يصل العميل بريد إيصال Stripe؟
items.q_reworded: Why did a buyer get our receipt but nothing from Stripe?
answer_must: Stripe customer emails, including successful-payment emails, are deliberately off

items.q_en: Someone opened a second account with the same phone number. What does the seat check?
items.q_ar: فتح شخص حساباً ثانياً برقم الهاتف نفسه، ماذا يفحص المقعد؟
items.q_reworded: Two sign-ups share a mobile number. What does finance look at?
answer_must: Whether the accounts are linked by equal identifiers
A link is flagged as a possible duplicate account

items.q_en: What signs suggest a supplier is dodging our fee?
items.q_ar: ما العلامات التي تشير إلى أن مورّداً يتهرب من رسومنا؟
items.q_reworded: What behaviour suggests a vendor is trying to avoid paying our commission?
answer_must: Signals of off-platform dealing are treated as circumvention and investigated

items.q_en: A supplier dealt with the customer off-platform before the reveal. What is the penalty?
items.q_ar: تعامل مورّد مع العميل خارج المنصة قبل الكشف، ما الغرامة؟
items.q_reworded: A vendor contacted the buyer directly before unlocking. What do we charge?
answer_must: AED 20,000 per incident under the anti-circumvention clause

items.q_en: Where do receipts need to be sent so they get booked?
items.q_ar: إلى أين تُرسل الإيصالات لكي تُقيد؟
items.q_reworded: I have a receipt from a software vendor. Where do I forward it?
answer_must: To expenses@mail.quotesdone.com

items.q_en: Some old forwarded receipts are missing from Resend. Were they lost?
items.q_ar: بعض الإيصالات القديمة المحوّلة غير موجودة في Resend، هل ضاعت؟
items.q_reworded: Some forwarded receipts from months ago are not in Resend anymore. Are they gone?
answer_must: Resend keeps inbound mail only about one month
They were captured in inbound_messages, so not lost

items.q_en: The OpenAI bill is not on the bank statement. Should that be flagged?
items.q_ar: فاتورة OpenAI غير موجودة في كشف البنك، هل نبلغ عن ذلك؟
items.q_reworded: Our AI subscription does not appear on the bank statement. Problem?
answer_must: It is paid on the founder's personal card, so its absence from the bank is expected
It is still a company expense

items.q_en: A receipt image is blurry and the amount cannot be read. Do we estimate it?
items.q_ar: صورة إيصال غير واضحة ولا يُقرأ المبلغ، هل نقدّره؟
items.q_reworded: The amount on a photo of a receipt is unreadable. Do we guess?
answer_must: No estimate is booked; the receipt is held until resolved

items.q_en: How do we tie a Stripe payout to the bank?
items.q_ar: كيف نربط دفعة Stripe بالبنك؟
items.q_reworded: How do we prove the money Stripe sent matches what landed in the bank?
answer_must: Each payout is matched to the bank line and to its balance transactions

items.q_en: What is the accounting source of truth inside Stripe?
items.q_ar: ما مرجع المحاسبة الموثوق داخل Stripe؟
items.q_reworded: Inside Stripe, which records do the books rely on?
answer_must: Balance transactions are the accounting source of truth

items.q_en: A name on our supplier list matches the UN list. Can we delete the account?
items.q_ar: اسم في قائمة موردينا يطابق قائمة الأمم المتحدة، هل نحذف الحساب؟
items.q_reworded: A supplier name hits the UN list. Should we just remove them?
answer_must: No deletion: the party is banned and sealed, records kept

items.q_en: Which sanctions lists does the daily re-screen use?
items.q_ar: ما قوائم العقوبات التي يستخدمها الفحص اليومي؟
items.q_reworded: Against which lists do we check suppliers every day?
answer_must: The UN Consolidated List and the UAE local terrorist list

items.q_en: A screen shows a partial name match. How is it dispositioned?
items.q_ar: أظهر الفحص تطابقاً جزئياً في الاسم، كيف يُعالج؟
items.q_reworded: The screen found a similar but not identical name. What now?
answer_must: It is a partial match that is investigated and dispositioned, with activity suspended meanwhile

items.q_en: What goes into the weekly finance report to the CEO?
items.q_ar: ماذا يتضمن التقرير المالي الأسبوعي للرئيس التنفيذي؟
items.q_reworded: What does the CEO get from finance every week?
answer_must: Cash position
Decisions needed from the CEO

items.q_en: The bank statement PDF would not parse. Do we ask the founder to resend?
items.q_ar: لم يُقرأ ملف كشف البنك، هل نطلب من المؤسس إعادة الإرسال؟
items.q_reworded: The monthly bank PDF failed to parse. Do we ask the owner to send it again?
answer_must: No, a parse failure is treated as our own defect to fix

items.q_en: What does Mashreq charge us each month?
items.q_ar: كم يتقاضى مشرق منا شهرياً؟
items.q_reworded: What is the monthly account fee at our bank?
answer_must: AED 199 plus AED 9.95 VAT

items.q_en: The founder transferred AED 5,000 into the company account. Is that a loan?
items.q_ar: حوّل المؤسس 5,000 درهم إلى حساب الشركة، هل هي قرض؟
items.q_reworded: The owner sent five thousand dirhams to the company. Do we record a loan to him?
answer_must: It is capital, not a loan, unless he says otherwise

items.q_en: What does the month-end close involve?
items.q_ar: ماذا يشمل الإقفال في نهاية الشهر؟
items.q_reworded: What happens at the end of every month in the books?
answer_must: A close: reconciliations, accruals, review, then the period is closed

items.q_en: Can a closed month be edited afterwards?
items.q_ar: هل يمكن تعديل شهر مقفل لاحقاً؟
expected_facts: postings dated in that month must be blocked
items.q_reworded: Can someone post a correction into a month that is already closed?
answer_must: No, postings dated in a locked month are blocked; corrections go in the open period

items.q_en: How is runway worked out for the CEO?
items.q_ar: كيف تُحسب المدة التشغيلية المتاحة للرئيس التنفيذي؟
items.q_reworded: How many months can we keep going with the cash we have?
answer_must: Runway = cash divided by monthly net burn, reported to the CEO

items.q_en: We had no ad spend this month. Does the Meta reconciliation still run?
items.q_ar: لم يكن لدينا إنفاق إعلاني هذا الشهر، هل تعمل مطابقة Meta مع ذلك؟
items.q_reworded: Marketing spent nothing on ads this month. Is the ad reconciliation skipped?
answer_must: No, it still runs at zero spend during the organic-only period

items.q_en: What should be budgeted for the eTrader licence?
items.q_ar: كم يجب رصده لرخصة التاجر الإلكتروني؟
items.q_reworded: How much do we set aside for renewing the eTrader licence?

items.q_en: When does the trade licence expire?
items.q_ar: متى تنتهي الرخصة التجارية؟
items.q_reworded: When is our trade licence up for renewal?
answer_must: 24 June 2027

items.q_en: At what revenue do we have to register for VAT?
items.q_ar: عند أي إيراد يجب التسجيل في ضريبة القيمة المضافة؟
items.q_reworded: What turnover forces us to register for VAT?
answer_must: AED 375,000 of taxable supplies

items.q_en: Once we cross the threshold, how long to apply?
items.q_ar: بعد تجاوز الحد، ما المهلة لتقديم طلب التسجيل؟
items.q_reworded: We just passed the VAT line. What is the deadline to apply?
answer_must: Within 30 days

items.q_en: Should the accountant keep a corporate-tax calendar?
items.q_ar: هل يحتفظ المحاسب بتقويم لضريبة الشركات؟
items.q_reworded: Should finance be running a corporate tax filing schedule?
answer_must: No; the founder said to ignore the corporate tax matter (instruction 344)
The VAT threshold is the tax duty the seat watches

items.q_en: What does the year-end pack contain?
items.q_ar: ماذا تتضمن حزمة نهاية السنة؟
items.q_reworded: What is in the annual accounts package?
answer_must: Statement of financial position, income statement, statement of cash flows and notes

items.q_en: What can the accountant decide without the CEO?
items.q_ar: ما الذي يقرره المحاسب دون الرئيس التنفيذي؟
items.q_reworded: Which things can finance decide alone?
answer_must: Booking, categorisation and reconciliation decisions
Money-out and policy decisions go to the CEO

items.q_en: Can the accountant email a supplier the charge notice directly?
items.q_ar: هل يرسل المحاسب إشعار المطالبة للمورّد بالبريد مباشرة؟
items.q_reworded: Can finance write to a supplier directly about what they owe?
answer_must: No, only customer_support sends email; finance hands the notice over

items.q_en: Books current within how long?
items.q_ar: خلال كم من الوقت يجب أن تكون الدفاتر محدّثة؟
items.q_reworded: How fresh must the books be, and when must the month be closed?
answer_must: Within 24 hours
Closed by day 5

items.q_en: How often is Stripe matched to the books?
items.q_ar: كم مرة تُطابق Stripe مع الدفاتر؟
items.q_reworded: How often is Stripe tied out to the ledger?
answer_must: Daily

items.q_en: When will the first reveal revenue come in?
items.q_ar: متى يصل أول إيراد من الكشوف؟
items.q_reworded: When do we expect the first unlock income?
answer_must: From January 2027, when customers start

items.q_en: Which supplier is the first to pay a subscription?
items.q_ar: من أول مورّد يدفع اشتراكاً؟
items.q_reworded: Who pays a subscription first and how much?
answer_must: Supplier 1,001 onwards pays AED 1,000 a year

items.q_en: We find a revenue line in November 2026. What is it likely to be?
items.q_ar: وجدنا بند إيراد في نوفمبر 2026، ما الأرجح أن يكون؟
items.q_reworded: An income line appears in November 2026 although customers start later. What is it?
answer_must: It is an anomaly to investigate, since reveal revenue starts in January 2027

items.q_en: How should a new expense be classified?
items.q_ar: كيف يُصنّف مصروف جديد؟
items.q_reworded: How do we decide which account a new bill belongs to?
answer_must: By what the cost is for, reasoned from the document, not by keyword

items.q_en: Where does a bank charge go in the chart of accounts?
items.q_ar: أين يُقيد رسم البنك في دليل الحسابات؟
items.q_reworded: Where is the monthly bank fee recorded?
answer_must: 6300 General and Administrative

items.q_en: We paid a Google Ads bill in USD. At what rate do we book it?
items.q_ar: دفعنا فاتورة إعلانات بالدولار، بأي سعر نقيدها؟
items.q_reworded: A dollar ad invoice was paid. Which exchange rate do we use?
answer_must: 3.6725 AED per USD, the pegged rate

items.q_en: We booked this vendor last month. Does the seat remember how?
items.q_ar: قيدنا هذا المورّد الشهر الماضي، هل يتذكر المقعد كيف؟
expected_facts: remembers how each vendor was treated
items.q_reworded: A vendor billed us again. Does finance reuse how it booked them last time?
answer_must: Yes, the seat remembers how each vendor was treated and reuses it unless facts changed

items.q_en: ما رسوم حساب مشرق الشهرية وعلى أي حساب تُقيد؟ أجب بالعربية.
items.q_ar: ما رسوم حساب مشرق الشهرية وعلى أي حساب تُقيد؟
items.q_reworded: What does Mashreq charge monthly and to which account? Answer in Arabic.
answer_must: AED 199 a month (plus VAT)
Booked to general and administrative

items.q_en: When may QuotesDone recognise a deferred tax asset for its pre-revenue tax losses?
items.q_ar: متى يجوز لكوتس دن إثبات أصل ضريبي مؤجل عن خسائرها الضريبية قبل الإيراد؟
items.q_reworded: Can we put our start-up tax losses on the balance sheet as an asset?
answer_must: Only when future taxable profit is probable

items.q_en: Can the cost of building the QuotesDone platform in-house be capitalised under IFRS for SMEs?
items.q_ar: هل يمكن رسملة تكلفة بناء منصة كوتس دن داخلياً وفق معيار المنشآت الصغيرة والمتوسطة؟
items.q_reworded: Our developers built the platform. Can we capitalise that cost?
answer_must: No, under IFRS for SMEs development cost is an expense when incurred

items.q_en: Where does the founder's capital injection go in the statement of cash flows?
items.q_ar: أين تُصنّف مساهمة المؤسس الرأسمالية في قائمة التدفقات النقدية؟
items.q_reworded: The owner put money in. Which part of the cash flow statement shows it?
answer_must: Financing activities, never operating

items.q_en: A disputed charge open at year end settled in January at a different amount. Adjust or disclose?
items.q_ar: رسم متنازع عليه في نهاية السنة سُوّي في يناير بمبلغ مختلف. هل نعدّل أم نفصح؟
items.q_reworded: A dispute at year-end settled in January for a different amount. Do we change the year-end numbers?
answer_must: Yes if it gives evidence of conditions at year end: an adjusting event

items.q_en: Are subscriptions the founder pays on his personal card related party transactions?
items.q_ar: هل الاشتراكات التي يدفعها المؤسس على بطاقته الشخصية معاملات أطراف ذات علاقة؟
items.q_reworded: Subscriptions the owner pays on his own card: are they related party items?
answer_must: Yes, they are related party transactions by definition and disclosed

items.q_en: How far ahead must the going concern assessment look?
items.q_ar: إلى أي مدى يجب أن يمتد تقييم الاستمرارية؟
items.q_reworded: How far forward must we look when judging if the company can continue?
answer_must: At least twelve months from the reporting date

items.q_en: A refund provision rate is revised. Do we restate the prior period?
items.q_ar: عُدّلت نسبة مخصص الاستردادات. هل نعيد عرض الفترة السابقة؟
items.q_reworded: We changed our expected refund rate. Do we restate last year?
answer_must: No, a change in estimate is applied prospectively

items.q_en: Can the non-response charge we are pursuing through legal recovery be booked as income?
items.q_ar: هل يمكن قيد رسم عدم الاستجابة الذي نلاحقه قانونياً كإيراد؟
items.q_reworded: We are suing a supplier for an unpaid charge. Can we record it as income now?
answer_must: No, it is a contingent asset, not income, until virtually certain

items.q_en: What is the de minimis threshold under the Corporate Tax interest limitation rule?
items.q_ar: ما حد الإعفاء الأدنى في قاعدة تقييد خصم الفائدة في ضريبة الشركات؟
items.q_reworded: Below what interest expense does the interest cap not bite?
answer_must: Net interest up to AED 12 million is deductible regardless (30% of EBITDA above)

items.q_en: How long after the supply before VAT bad debt relief can be claimed?
items.q_ar: كم يجب أن يمضي من تاريخ التوريد قبل المطالبة بإعفاء الديون المعدومة؟
items.q_reworded: When can we reclaim VAT on an invoice a customer never paid?
answer_must: Only after more than six months from the supply, with the other Article 64 conditions met

items.q_en: What corporate tax rate applies to QuotesDone's profit?
items.q_ar: ما نسبة ضريبة الشركات المطبقة على أرباح كوتس دن؟
expected_facts: 0% rate on taxable income up to AED 375,000
items.q_reworded: If we make a profit next year, how much tax do we pay on it?
answer_must: 0% up to AED 375,000 of taxable income
9% on the excess

items.q_en: Does a sole establishment have to register for corporate tax?
items.q_ar: هل يجب على المؤسسة الفردية التسجيل في ضريبة الشركات؟
items.q_reworded: The founder owns the licence personally. When must it get a tax number?
answer_must: A natural person registers once business turnover exceeds AED 1,000,000 in a calendar year

items.q_en: What does it cost us if we register for corporate tax late?
items.q_ar: ما تكلفة التأخر في التسجيل لضريبة الشركات؟
items.q_reworded: We missed the tax sign-up date. How bad is it?
answer_must: An AED 10,000 penalty
The FTA waiver removes it if the first return is filed within seven months of the period end

items.q_en: For a December year-end, when are the corporate tax return and payment due?
items.q_ar: لسنة مالية تنتهي في ديسمبر، متى يستحق إقرار ضريبة الشركات والدفع؟
items.q_reworded: Our books end in December. By when must tax be filed and paid?
answer_must: Within 9 months: 30 September of the next year
Even if no tax is payable

items.q_en: Can we elect Small Business Relief, and until when is it available?
items.q_ar: هل يمكننا اختيار إعفاء الأعمال الصغيرة، وحتى متى هو متاح؟
items.q_reworded: Our turnover is small. Can we be treated as having no taxable income?
answer_must: Yes if revenue is at or below AED 3 million
For periods ending by 31 December 2029

items.q_en: How do we get from the profit in the accounts to the taxable income figure?
items.q_ar: كيف ننتقل من الربح في الحسابات إلى الدخل الخاضع للضريبة؟
items.q_reworded: The accounts show a profit. Is that the number we pay tax on?
answer_must: Start from accounting net profit and adjust for non-deductible items, exempt income and related-party adjustments

items.q_en: How much of a client dinner is deductible for corporate tax?
items.q_ar: ما الجزء القابل للخصم من عشاء عمل مع عميل لأغراض ضريبة الشركات؟
items.q_reworded: I took a supplier to lunch. Can the company deduct all of it?
answer_must: Only 50% of client entertainment is deductible

items.q_en: Which transfer pricing methods does the corporate tax law name?
items.q_ar: ما طرق تسعير التحويل التي ينص عليها قانون ضريبة الشركات؟
items.q_reworded: How do we prove a deal with the owner was priced fairly?
answer_must: Apply the arm's length standard
Using one of five methods: CUP, resale price, cost plus, TNMM, profit split

items.q_en: We will make losses this year. How much of them can we use against later profit?
items.q_ar: سنحقق خسائر هذا العام، كم منها يمكن استخدامه مقابل أرباح لاحقة؟
items.q_reworded: When we turn profitable, can the old losses wipe out all the tax?
answer_must: Losses carry forward but can offset at most 75% of taxable income in a period

items.q_en: We pay VAT on a local software subscription. Can we book it as recoverable?
items.q_ar: ندفع ضريبة قيمة مضافة على اشتراك برمجيات محلي، هل نقيدها كضريبة قابلة للاسترداد؟
items.q_reworded: A Dubai vendor charged us 5%. Can we claim it back?
answer_must: No, while unregistered the VAT is part of the cost of the expense

items.q_en: How is VAT handled on a cloud bill from a foreign provider once we are registered?
items.q_ar: كيف تُعالج ضريبة القيمة المضافة على فاتورة سحابية من مزود أجنبي بعد تسجيلنا؟
items.q_reworded: After registering, what about tax on our overseas SaaS bills?
answer_must: They are reverse charged: we declare 5% output tax and recover it as input where allowed

items.q_en: Where is our service supplied for VAT purposes as a general rule?
items.q_ar: أين يُعتبر مكان توريد خدمتنا لأغراض ضريبة القيمة المضافة كقاعدة عامة؟
items.q_reworded: For tax, in which country is our service treated as provided?
answer_must: The supplier's place of residence, i.e. the UAE, as a general rule

items.q_en: Can a fee charged to a customer abroad be zero-rated?
items.q_ar: هل يمكن إخضاع رسوم محصلة من عميل في الخارج لنسبة الصفر؟
items.q_reworded: A buyer based in Oman paid a fee. Do we charge 5%?
answer_must: No VAT is charged: QuotesDone is not VAT-registered, so neither 5% nor zero-rating applies today
Once registered, a fee to a non-resident outside the UAE can be zero-rated if the service is not tied to UAE real estate or goods

items.q_en: Once VAT-registered, how soon after the supply must the tax invoice be issued?
items.q_ar: بعد التسجيل في الضريبة، خلال كم يوماً من التوريد يجب إصدار الفاتورة الضريبية؟
items.q_reworded: After we register, how long do we have to send a proper tax invoice?
answer_must: Within 14 days of the supply

items.q_en: When is the VAT201 return due after the period ends?
items.q_ar: متى يستحق إقرار ضريبة القيمة المضافة 201 بعد نهاية الفترة؟
items.q_reworded: When must the VAT return be filed and paid?
answer_must: Within 28 days after the end of the tax period

items.q_en: If we pay tax late, what is the penalty now?
items.q_ar: إذا تأخرنا في سداد الضريبة، ما الغرامة حالياً؟
items.q_reworded: Our VAT payment was a month late. What is the charge?
answer_must: 14% per annum, applied monthly, since 14 April 2026

items.q_en: How will UAE e-invoicing actually move our invoices?
items.q_ar: كيف سينقل نظام الفوترة الإلكترونية في الإمارات فواتيرنا فعلياً؟
items.q_reworded: What system will carry electronic invoices in the UAE?
answer_must: Through the Peppol network
Via an Accredited Service Provider

items.q_en: How long must we keep the records behind a corporate tax return?
items.q_ar: كم من الوقت يجب الاحتفاظ بالسجلات المؤيدة لإقرار ضريبة الشركات؟
items.q_reworded: Can we delete old receipts after a few years?
answer_must: Keep corporate tax records seven years after the period

items.q_en: A bank asks for our Economic Substance report. Do we have to file one?
items.q_ar: طلب البنك تقرير المادة الاقتصادية، هل يجب أن نقدمه؟
items.q_reworded: An adviser says we need an ESR filing. True?
answer_must: No, ESR ceased for years ending after 31 December 2022 (Cabinet Decision 98 of 2024)

items.q_en: Which accounting framework do we report under, and which edition?
items.q_ar: ما إطار المحاسبة الذي نعد تقاريرنا وفقه، وأي إصدار؟
items.q_reworded: What standards do our financial statements follow?
answer_must: IFRS for SMEs
The 2025 third edition, effective 1 January 2027

items.q_en: Walk me through how we decide when a fee becomes revenue.
items.q_ar: اشرح لي كيف نقرر متى تصبح الرسوم إيراداً.
items.q_reworded: When exactly can we count an unlock payment as earned?
answer_must: Apply the five steps: contract, obligations, price, allocation, recognition when satisfied

items.q_en: Do we book the full quotation value as our revenue?
items.q_ar: هل نقيد قيمة عرض السعر كاملة كإيراد لنا؟
expected_facts: platform's own supply is its service
items.q_reworded: The deal is worth AED 200,000. Is that our sales figure?
answer_must: No, QuotesDone is agent and records only its fee

items.q_en: A customer prepaid for reveal credits they may never use. How is the cash held?
items.q_ar: دفع عميل مسبقاً مقابل أرصدة كشف قد لا يستخدمها، كيف يُعالج النقد؟
items.q_reworded: If a buyer prepays and never uses the credits, when do we earn it?
answer_must: Cash is a contract liability
Expected breakage is recognised in proportion to use

items.q_en: We paid an annual SaaS plan upfront. Do we expense it all this month?
items.q_ar: دفعنا اشتراكاً سنوياً مقدماً، هل نصرفه كله هذا الشهر؟
items.q_reworded: We bought a yearly tool licence today. Full cost hits this month?
answer_must: No, it is a prepayment expensed over the service period

items.q_en: The usage bill for this month arrives next month. What do we do at month end?
items.q_ar: فاتورة الاستخدام لهذا الشهر تصل الشهر القادم، ماذا نفعل في نهاية الشهر؟
items.q_reworded: The API bill for October only comes in November. How is October right?
answer_must: Accrue the estimated usage-billed cost in October

items.q_en: We are taking a co-working desk for six months. Does it go on the balance sheet?
items.q_ar: سنستأجر مكتباً في مساحة عمل مشتركة لستة أشهر، هل يظهر في الميزانية؟
items.q_reworded: A short desk rental: asset and liability or just expense?
answer_must: A lease of 12 months or less can be expensed straight-line

items.q_en: Do we need an external auditor for our accounts?
items.q_ar: هل نحتاج إلى مدقق خارجي لحساباتنا؟
items.q_reworded: Does the law require someone to audit our books yearly?
answer_must: No external audit is legally required today: QuotesDone is a sole establishment, not an LLC, so the company-law auditor duty does not apply, and CT needs audited statements only above AED 50 million revenue or for a Qualifying Free Zone Person
Keep the year-end pack audit-ready and re-check if revenue nears AED 50 million or the legal form changes

items.q_en: What must every journal entry carry so it can be traced?
items.q_ar: ما الذي يجب أن يحمله كل قيد يومية ليمكن تتبعه؟
items.q_reworded: If an auditor picks a number, how do we show where it came from?
answer_must: Each entry links to its source document with IDs, dates, accounts and actor

items.q_en: Who approves and who executes a refund among the seats?
items.q_ar: من يوافق ومن ينفذ الاسترداد بين المقاعد؟
items.q_reworded: Can one seat both decide and pay a refund?
answer_must: No: the CEO seat approves, the accountant executes, reconciliation checks independently

items.q_en: An email asks us to send a refund to a new bank account. What do we do?
items.q_ar: وصلتنا رسالة تطلب إرسال استرداد إلى حساب بنكي جديد، ماذا نفعل؟
items.q_reworded: A supplier emailed new bank details and wants payment there urgently. Proceed?
answer_must: Do not pay until verified by call-back to a number on file
Refunds go only to the original Stripe charge

items.q_en: How many weeks ahead does our cash forecast run, and what is opening cash?
items.q_ar: كم أسبوعاً يغطي توقع النقد لدينا، وما النقد الافتتاحي؟
items.q_reworded: How far ahead do we plan cash, week by week?
answer_must: 13 weeks
Opening cash is Mashreq plus Stripe available balance

items.q_en: How should next year's revenue budget be built?
items.q_ar: كيف يجب إعداد موازنة إيرادات العام القادم؟
items.q_reworded: Can we just budget a round revenue number for 2027?
answer_must: No, build revenue from drivers, never a top-down total

items.q_en: How do we calculate our take rate?
items.q_ar: كيف نحسب نسبة الاقتطاع لدينا؟
items.q_reworded: What share of deal value are we actually keeping?
answer_must: Take rate = fee revenue divided by GMV for the same transactions

items.q_en: What net fee rate per reveal should the accountant see?
items.q_ar: ما صافي نسبة الرسوم لكل كشف الذي يجب أن يراه المحاسب؟
items.q_reworded: Out of every reveal we collect, what share should land as our net fee?
answer_must: The net fee rate per reveal is 3.00% of the quotation value

items.q_en: How do we stop stolen cards being used to pay for reveals?
items.q_ar: كيف نمنع استخدام بطاقات مسروقة لدفع رسوم الكشف؟
items.q_reworded: How do we keep fraudsters with stolen cards from paying for unlocks?
answer_must: Use 3D Secure (Strong Customer Authentication) on card payments, with Stripe Radar rules

items.q_en: What ownership level makes someone a beneficial owner in the UAE?
items.q_ar: ما نسبة الملكية التي تجعل الشخص مالكاً مستفيداً في الإمارات؟
items.q_reworded: At what stake does a shareholder count as the real owner we must record?
answer_must: A beneficial owner holds 25% or more of the ownership or voting rights, or otherwise controls the entity

items.q_en: Are we a designated non-financial business under the AML rules?
items.q_ar: هل نحن من الأعمال والمهن غير المالية المحددة بموجب قواعد مكافحة غسل الأموال؟
items.q_reworded: Do the anti-money-laundering rules treat a business like ours as a designated non-financial business?
answer_must: Answer by the current DNFBP list under Cabinet Resolution 134 of 2025, not by assumption

items.q_en: If we suspect money laundering, can we warn the customer?
items.q_ar: إذا اشتبهنا في غسل أموال، هل يمكننا تنبيه العميل؟
items.q_reworded: We think a buyer may be laundering money. Should we let them know we are looking into it?
answer_must: No: it is an offence to tip off the customer; report through goAML and say nothing to them

items.q_en: What gratuity does an employee earn for the first five years?
items.q_ar: ما مكافأة نهاية الخدمة التي يستحقها الموظف عن السنوات الخمس الأولى؟
items.q_reworded: When we hire, what end-of-service pay builds up in an employee's first five years?
answer_must: 21 days of basic wage for each year of the first five years

items.q_en: How must salaries be paid once we hire?
items.q_ar: كيف يجب دفع الرواتب بعد التوظيف؟
items.q_reworded: Once we have staff, through what system must their salaries be paid?
answer_must: Through the Wage Protection System (WPS)

items.q_en: Can the company pay the founder a salary and deduct it?
items.q_ar: هل يمكن للشركة دفع راتب للمؤسس وخصمه؟
items.q_reworded: Can the owner draw a salary from the company and count it as a deductible expense?
answer_must: Only at market value for real work done, documented; anything above is not deductible

items.q_en: How do you approach a tax question you have not seen before?
items.q_ar: كيف تتعامل مع سؤال ضريبي لم تره من قبل؟
items.q_reworded: A tax question comes up that nobody here has seen before. How do you work it out?
answer_must: Follow the accountant's reasoning sequence: identify the law and article, the facts, apply, state the conclusion and its confidence, and escalate what cannot be settled
